The original X post itself was not opened. Sanders had endorsed Jackson for GOVERNOR in May 2025 (https://www.bangordailynews.com/2025/05/21/politics/elections/maine-bernie-sanders-troy-jackson-endorsement-governor-election). DATE DISCREPANCY: the brief says Jackson replaced Platner in Aug 2026; sources say he was nominated 2026-07-25.
